notes: Mirrors the prefix-based categorize step that both interact_logchk and logchk2directory run on every record: strip line terminators, then SUBSTR + IF to set cate to ERROR/WARNING/NOTE/INFO. Feeds a small sample of realistic SAS log lines and confirms the 10-line input produces 1 ERROR + 1 WARNING + 1 INFO + 6 NOTE + 1 uncategorized (the page-header line is intentionally not flagged), matching the macro's behavior.
